events.summary: VisionToolParameterGuideView Partial is the required WPF presentation adapter. Presenter/catalog/binder/host/sidecar/shell already own selection, guidance policy, PropertyGrid events, lifetime and composition; no independent View state/lifetime/test seam justifies a production split. Keep the View boundary closed to mechanical Partial changes.

Close the concrete catalog defect: retain the normal TypeDescriptor path and add a public-instance reflection descriptor fallback only when a global PropertyGrid provider hides a valid dependent property. The fallback preserves attributes/localization and keeps visibility policy out of the View.

All three PL-0055 completion criteria are satisfied by the owner report, 14/14 Debug/Release source contracts, zero-error builds with recorded existing warnings, p257/p259/p260 Debug/Release WPF prechecks, and dynamic monitor/window evidence.
